_meta.description: US version. The tiering unit is the GICS 11 sector itself (no collapsing, unlike the JP 33->12 map). rank_us.py uses this.
_meta.grade: A(>=grade_a) / B(>=grade_b) / C by the median selection score within each GICS sector. A rough 'which sectors have the better-quality dividend names' guide.
_meta.tier: Within a sector, sort by selection score; top tier1_pct = Tier 1, next tier2_pct = Tier 2, rest = Tier 3. Low coverage is capped at Tier 2 (cap_low_coverage_at). Plus an absolute-score floor (rank_us.py tier_floor): a name with selection score >= analyze_us.SEL_TIERS[0] (85) is guaranteed at least Tier 2 so it does not fall to Tier 3 just for sitting in a strong sector.
_meta.min_group: A GICS sector with fewer than min_group_for_tiers screened names is shown flat (no tiering).
_meta.grade_a/grade_b calibration: Calibrated 2026-09-06 from the full 501-name batch. GICS sector SEL medians ran 80.1 (Real Estate) to 91.5 (Information Technology); 88/84 gives a ~4A/3B/4C split. Re-check with batch_calib_us.py after a universe rebuild.
